summary: Ascendis Pharma A/S filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) disclosing that on September 14, 2026 its Board of Directors authorized repurchasing up to $400 million of ordinary shares. No price per share, premium, or expiration date was stated; execution may occur via open-market purchases, privately negotiated transactions, block trades, accelerated share repurchase transactions, or Rule 10b5-1 plans. The program is discretionary, has no fixed share count, and may be modified, suspended, or terminated at any time without notice, leaving buyback timing dependent on market conditions and share price.
